transcript:
Okay, this is a weird one to log because I'm not sure what's
happening and I don't want to catastrophize but I also want to get it on
record. So the last four or five days, maybe five, I've been having this
intermittent twitching in my left calf like a muscle fasciculation comes
and goes. Actually, usually in the evening when I'm sitting down, not
during exercise. It's completely painless, just disconcerting. I have
been googling which I know I shouldn't. It could be magnesium deficiency
but I'm already taking magnesium glycinate so that seems unlikely. Could
be dehydration. I have been a bit low on water this week. Could be just
some people get this. They're benign, totally normal, especially if
you're exercising a lot. Or there's the anxiety connection. I have been
more stressed lately. The berberine dose change was three weeks ago so
probably not that. I'm going to mention it to a doctor next time. I
talked to him but I don't want to have a whole call about it. I have
been trying to just ignore. It's been there again tonight while I'm
recording this.
